definitions.explanation: A staircase that turns around a central axis as it rises. Found in towers, lighthouses, and narrow buildings where a straight flight would not fit.

examples.japanese: らせん{階段|かいだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|のぼ}った→上る：21460_noboru⟧。
examples.english: I went up the spiral staircase.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二階|にかい}→二階：27513_nikai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧らせん{階段|かいだん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧つながって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This shop is connected to the second floor by a spiral staircase.

examples.japanese: ⟦{灯台|とうだい}→灯台：04560_toudai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧らせん{階段|かいだん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧で、⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れた→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
examples.english: The lighthouse's spiral staircase was steep, and I was out of breath by the time I reached the top.

notes:
らせん (spiral, helix) + ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧ (stairs). らせん is normally written in kana; the kanji {螺旋|らせん} appears mostly in older or decorative text.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- らせん{階段|かいだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|のぼ}る→上る：21460_noboru⟧／{下|お}りる: to go up/down a spiral staircase
- ⟦{鉄|てつ}→鉄：02225_tetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧らせん{階段|かいだん}: an iron spiral staircase
- らせん⟦{状|じょう}→状：09878_jou⟧: spiral-shaped (the same らせん used of anything that coils)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧: stairs — the general word
- ⟦{回|まわ}り→回る：01150_mawaru⟧⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧: winding stairs — a stairway that turns, without necessarily coiling around a single post
